author: Ari Koslow
title: Tanner Bibee to start Sunday
desc: Tanner Bibee will start on Sunday against the Pirates.
impact: Bibee will close out the first series out of the All-Star break for Cleveland. He posted a 3.90 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joey Cantillo to start Saturday for Guardians
desc: Joey Cantillo will start on Saturday against the Pirates.
impact: Cantillo delivered a strong 1.80 ERA across three starts in July. He'll look to continue that out of the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Williams to start Friday for Guardians
desc: Gavin Williams will start on Friday against the Pirates.
impact: Williams will take the mound first out of the All-Star break for Cleveland. He posted a 3.81 ERA the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Scott Blewett opts out of minor league deal with Cardinals
desc: Scott Blewett is opting out of his minor league deal with the Cardinals.
impact: The Cardinals will have 48 hours to add Blewett to their 40-man or make him a free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tommy White to be called up by Athletics
desc: The Athletics are promoting Tommy White to the majors.
impact: White was the Athletics' second round pick in 2024. He has slashed .303/.345/.489 in 55 games in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendan Donovan (groin) begins rehab assignment Wednesday
desc: Brendan Donovan will begin his rehab assignment on Wednesday with the Mariners' affiliate in the Arizona Complex League.
impact: Donovan was expected to begin his rehab assignment earlier, but it is officially happening Wednesday evening. He'll likely require a lengthy rehab assignment following a long absence.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Aaron Civale designated for assignment
desc: The Athletics designated RHP Aaron Civale for assignment.
impact: Civale loses his spot on the Athletics 40-man roster. He'll likely pass through waivers and elect free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yunior Tur has contract selected by Athletics
desc: The Athletics selected the contract of RHP Yunior Tur from Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Tur will be making his major league debut when he first gets into a game. He should begin in a low-leverage role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brian Serven optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Athletics optioned C Brian Serven to Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Serven returns to Triple-A out of the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Donovan Walton activated by Athletics
impact: Walton was claimed off waivers from the Angels. He'll add infield depth for the Athletics.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joey Meneses optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Athletics optioned 1B Joey Meneses to Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Meneses will return to Triple-A following the All-Star break. Donovan Walton was activated as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Barnett optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Athletics optioned RHP Mason Barnett to Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Barnett struggled in the couple of weeks leading into the All-Star break. He should get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brady Basso recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Athletics recalled LHP Brady Basso from Triple-A Las Vegas.
impact: Basso will be back for another stint in the majors. He'll remain in a low-leverage role for the Athletics.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Austin Voth granted release by Rangers
desc: The Rangers have granted right-hander Austin Voth his release.
impact: The Rangers signed Voth to a minors pact earlier this month, and made just one start for Triple-A Round Rock. He has also spent time at Triple-A with the Blue Jays and Twins this season. Voth owns a career 4.84 ERA across 210 big-league appearances, 39 of which have been starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Colton Gordon being viewed as starter by Brewers
desc: The Brewers are reportedly viewing Colton Gordon as a starter.
impact: Gordon was acquired by Milwaukee from the Astros on Wednesday. He has made just one start across four appearances this season, but he made 14 starts last year. He is expected to report to Triple-A Nashville.
